title: A Pre-Registered Test of Entropy–Structure Coupling in Simulated and Observed Galaxy Clusters
description: Pre-registered analysis comparing the coupling between entropy-profile steepness and cool-core state in TNG-Cluster simulations versus the ACCEPT X-ray sample. Finds a strong negative correlation between density-slope-based entropy proxy and central entropy in TNG-Cluster, opposite in sign to the positive correlation reported in ACCEPT, and registers a decisive full-profile fit to resolve remaining systematics.

cavagnolo_entropy_profile.description: Parametric model used by ACCEPT to fit deprojected ICM entropy profiles; K0 is central entropy, K100 a normalization, and alpha the entropy gradient steepness.

entropy_slope_decomposition.latex: \alpha = \frac{d\ln K}{d\ln r} = \frac{d\ln T}{d\ln r} + \frac{2}{3}\left(-\frac{d\ln n_e}{d\ln r}\right)
entropy_slope_decomposition.description: Decomposition of the logarithmic entropy slope into temperature and density gradient contributions.

alpha_proxy_definition.description: Lower-bound proxy for the entropy slope using only the electron-density logarithmic slope; used for the pre-registered Path B proxy test.

key_results.main_finding: TNG-Cluster shows a strong negative correlation between entropy-gradient proxy and central entropy (rho = -0.872), opposite in sign to the positive coupling reported in ACCEPT (rho ~ +0.36).

sealed_predictions.statement: Using the pre-registered Path A full-profile fit over 20–400 kpc with the Cavagnolo model, the TNG-Cluster correlation rho(alpha_fit, K0) will be negative and significant, confirming the sign flip relative to ACCEPT.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Execute the Path A fit exactly as pre-registered; compute Spearman rho(alpha_fit, K0) over all 352 halos and test for rho >= 0 at p < 0.01.

sealed_predictions.statement: The negative correlation between entropy-gradient measure and K0 in TNG-Cluster will persist within each of four mass bins spanning 10^14–10^15.5 Msun.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Recompute mass-binned Spearman correlations for alpha_fit or alpha_proxy vs K0 in the predefined four M500c bins; rejection if any bin shows rho >= 0 with p < 0.05 after multiple-testing correction.

kill_criteria: KC1: The pre-registered Path A full-profile fit yields a non-negative correlation between alpha_fit and K0 in TNG-Cluster (rho >= 0) with p < 0.01, eliminating the reported sign flip.

KC2: After matching the ACCEPT measurement pipeline (same radial range, deprojection weighting, and center choice), the TNG-Cluster correlation sign becomes positive and consistent with ACCEPT (e.g., rho >= +0.2 with p < 0.05).

KC3: Independent measurements show that core temperature gradients are sufficiently negative in a majority of halos (>= 50%), invalidating the monotonic lower-bound property of alpha_proxy and reversing rank ordering; proxy-based conclusions would then be withdrawn.

KC4: A re-analysis of ACCEPT with updated calibration and selection finds no positive coupling (rho(alpha, yCCT) ~ 0 with p > 0.1), removing the observational target and nullifying the claimed sim–obs mismatch.

KC5: Robust mass-control analyses (e.g., conditional randomization tests or stratified permutations) demonstrate that the negative correlation in TNG-Cluster is fully explained by mass confounding, reducing |rho| below 0.2 with p > 0.1.

paper.title: A Pre-Registered Test of Entropy–Structure Coupling in Simulated and Observed Galaxy Clusters
paper.author: Morten Magnusson

abstract: Tests whether the observed positive correlation between entropy profile steepness and cool-core state in ACCEPT X-ray clusters is reproduced in TNG-Cluster simulations. Finds a strong negative correlation (sign flip), robust against mass confounding.

key_result.description: Sign flip in entropy-structure coupling between simulation and observation
key_result.interpretation: Complete sign reversal indicates potential sim-obs mismatch in ICM physics

tng_cluster.description: 352 zoom simulations of massive galaxy clusters

accept.description: Archive of Chandra Cluster Entropy Profile Tables

alpha_proxy.interpretation: Lower bound on alpha under physical temperature gradient assumption

entropy_decomposition.description: Logarithmic entropy slope decomposed into temperature and density terms

mass_controlled.interpretation: Sign flip is NOT driven by mass confounding

ks_test_scc_vs_ncc.interpretation: Complete separation between SCC and NCC density slopes

path_a.name: Decisive Full Profile Fit
path_a.description: Full Cavagnolo-model K(r) fit over [20, 400] kpc

possible_explanations.name: Subgrid modelling
possible_explanations.description: AGN feedback in TNG may produce overly mechanical CC/NCC transitions

possible_explanations.name: Observational systematics
possible_explanations.description: Projection effects, spectral fitting biases, or selection effects in ACCEPT

possible_explanations.name: Missing physics
possible_explanations.description: Cosmic ray transport, anisotropic conduction, magnetic draping not captured

systematic_differences: ACCEPT: deprojected X-ray spectroscopic with emission weighting
interpretation.implications: Framework-independent question: Why do modern ΛCDM hydrodynamic simulations not reproduce the observed entropy-structure coupling?
